verses.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other.
The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul. The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
Be still, and know that I am God.
Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us.
A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God.
My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried.
Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy.
Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid.
Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer.
Be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord.
For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory.
And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day.
Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it.
And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus.
Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life.
Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again.
O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee.
The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
Though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee.
The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever.
There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me.
Men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee.
The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
Thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy.
Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart.
He that walketh with wise men shall be wise.
When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee.
In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
He hath made every thing beautiful in his time.
Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart.
By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.
I am the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit.
I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing.
I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence.
O LORD, thou art my God; I will exalt thee.
He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
Let thy words be few.
Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
A merry heart doeth good like a medicine.
And the work of righteousness shall be peace.
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life.
Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might.
O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee.
To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
Thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption.
Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk.
He that observeth the wind shall not sow.
The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer.
The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
I will greatly rejoice in the LORD.
Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth.
Wisdom is a defence.
